svg.title: Preemption by data kind and scheduling decision
svg.desc: Request and RNG stay resident. KV and hidden/token tensors move to CPU and back. Logical KV metadata is saved, physical mappings and execution metadata are rebuilt. Victim selection is shown in a separate companion diagram.
svg.text: 01 / Preserve identity. Move only the state that needs it.
One victim request, six data kinds. Read each lane from left to right.
Green: retained in runtime Purple: saved / restored Blue: reconstructed for execution
